en.text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? of men?

zhSimplified.text: 世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义吗？

zhTraditional.text: 世人哪，你們默然不語，真合公義嗎？

en.text: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.
The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人一出母胎就 神疏远，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人一出母胎就上帝疏遠，

en.text: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

zhSimplified.text: 他们的毒气好像蛇的毒气；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的毒氣好像蛇的毒氣；

en.text: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, the charmer may be.
Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你敲碎他们口中的牙！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你敲碎他們口中的牙！

en.text: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们消灭，如急流的水一般；

zhTraditional.text: 願他們消滅，如急流的水一般；

en.text: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們像蝸牛消化過去，

en.text: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

zhSimplified.text: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热，

zhTraditional.text: 你們用荊棘燒火，鍋還未熱，

en.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

zhSimplified.text: 因此，人必说：义人诚然有善报；

zhTraditional.text: 因此，人必說：義人誠然有善報；
